items.text: Has it been determined whether the operation takes place in national territory, aims to offer goods/services to or process data of individuals located in Brazil, or uses data collected in Brazil (any one is enough)?
terms: oferta ou o fornecimento de bens ou serviços

items.text: Was any Art. 4 exception assessed and documented (purely private non-economic purposes; journalistic/artistic/academic; public security and similar; data from abroad with no shared use)? For academic purposes, do Arts. 7 and 11 still apply?
Is each purpose legitimate, specific, explicit and informed to the data subject, with no incompatible further processing?
terms: propósitos legítimos, específicos, explícitos e informados

items.text: Is the processing compatible with the purposes informed, according to the context of the processing?
Is the data collected limited to the minimum necessary, relevant, proportionate and not excessive for each purpose?
Can the data subject consult, in a facilitated and free way, the form and duration of the processing and the completeness of their data?
Are there mechanisms to keep the data accurate, clear, relevant and up to date according to the purpose?
Is the information about the processing and the agents clear, precise and easily accessible (respecting trade and industrial secrets)?
Are there technical and administrative measures against unauthorized access and accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, communication or dissemination?
Have measures been adopted to prevent harm arising from the processing and to avoid unlawful or abusive discriminatory purposes?
Can effective compliance measures, and their effectiveness, be demonstrated with evidence (accountability)?
Is each processing operation linked to a basis in Art. 7 (or Art. 11, if sensitive) and is this recorded?
terms: somente poderá ser realizado nas seguintes hipóteses

items.text: If the basis is consent: was it given in writing (in a highlighted clause) or by another means that shows the data subject's will, for specific purposes, with no generic authorization, and can the controller prove it (burden of proof)?
Can consent be revoked at any time, expressly, through a free and facilitated procedure, and does the system propagate the revocation?
Are incompatible changes of purpose or changes to the information in Art. 9, I, II, III or V communicated prominently, with the possibility of revoking?
Is the information in Art. 9 (purpose, form and duration, controller, contact, shared use, responsibilities, rights) presented in a clear, adequate and conspicuous way?
If the processing is a condition for supplying a product/service or exercising a right, is the data subject informed prominently and about how to exercise their rights?
terms: condição para o fornecimento de produto ou de serviço

items.text: If the basis is legitimate interest: is there a legitimate purpose based on a concrete situation, only strictly necessary data, transparency, and readiness for a RIPD (Relatório de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais, data protection impact report) requested by the ANPD?
Does sharing with other controllers on the basis of consent have specific consent for that purpose (unless waived)?
terms: consentimento específico do titular para esse fim

items.text: Does publicly accessible data, or data manifestly made public, remain subject to purpose, good faith, public interest, data subject rights and the principles?
terms: não desobriga os agentes de tratamento

items.text: Was the data processed classified against the list of sensitive data in Art. 5, II (including health, genetic, biometric)?
For sensitive data, is there specific and prominent consent for specific purposes, or an indispensable basis from Art. 11, II (a-g)?
Was processing that reveals sensitive data and may cause harm handled under the Art. 11 regime (even if the data is not sensitive by nature)?
terms: revele dados pessoais sensíveis e que possa causar dano

items.text: Health data: were the prohibitions on sharing for economic advantage and on risk selection by health plan operators checked?
Does the claimed anonymization withstand the reversal test with own means or reasonable efforts (cost, time, technology)? Were behavioral profiles considered?

In public health research: is data processed only within the body, in a controlled and secure environment, with anonymization/pseudonymization, without transfer to third parties and without disclosing personal data?
Is the processing of children's and adolescents' data done in their best interest, and is there specific and prominent consent from at least one parent or guardian (children)?
Are reasonable efforts made to verify that consent was given by the guardian, considering the available technologies?
Do games and applications avoid conditioning participation on data beyond what is strictly necessary? Is public information about the types of data, use and rights available?
Is the information simple, clear and accessible, with audiovisual resources where appropriate, for the parent/guardian and for the child?
Are there criteria and a routine for ending the processing (purpose achieved, end of period, data subject request, ANPD order)?
After the end of processing, is data deleted, except for authorized retention (legal obligation, research, transfer to a third party, exclusive use by the controller in anonymized form)?
Is there a channel for the express request of the data subject or representative, and is the response free of charge?

Does the system handle confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/deletion, portability, deletion of data processed on consent, information about sharing and about the consequences of refusal (incisos I to IX)?
Is there an immediate simplified format and a complete declaration within 15 days for confirmation/access, and is data stored in a format that favors access?
When the origin is consent or a contract, can a full electronic copy in a reusable format be provided?
If an immediate response is not possible, does the reply state that the sender is not a processing agent (and who is) or give the factual or legal reasons?
terms: razões de fato ou de direito

items.text: Are correction, deletion, anonymization or blocking communicated immediately to the agents with whom the data was shared (unless impossible or a disproportionate effort)?
Do solely automated decisions that affect the data subject (personal, professional, consumer, credit profiles) allow a review request and give information on criteria and procedures?
terms: unicamente com base em tratamento automatizado

items.text: Is data about the data subject's regular exercise of rights not used to their detriment?
terms: não podem ser utilizados em seu prejuízo

items.text: (Public authority) Are the processing cases, legal basis, purpose, procedures and practices published in an easily accessible medium, and is an encarregado (DPO) appointed?
terms: previsão legal, a finalidade, os procedimentos

items.text: (Public authority) Do transfers to private entities occur only under the exceptions in Art. 26 §1, and were contracts/agreements communicated to the ANPD?

Does every international transfer rest on one of the Art. 33 cases (adequacy, contractual guarantees/standard clauses/global corporate rules/seals, cooperation, life, ANPD, agreement, public policy, specific and prominent consent, Art. 7 II, V, VI cases)?
When the basis is consent, was the data subject informed beforehand of the international nature of the operation, distinguishing it from other purposes?
Are changes to the guarantees presented as sufficient communicated to the ANPD?
Do the controller and the processor keep a record of processing operations (especially those based on legitimate interest)?
Does the processor process only according to the controller's instructions, and does the controller verify compliance?
terms: segundo as instruções fornecidas pelo controlador

items.text: Is an encarregado appointed, with identity and contact publicly disclosed in a clear way (preferably on the website)?
Does the encarregado receive complaints from data subjects and communications from the ANPD, and advise employees and contractors?
Do controller-processor contracts make clear the instructions, the processor's joint liability (Art. 42 §1, I) and the right of recourse (§4)?
Can the organization prove one of the Art. 43 exclusions or show the security the data subject may expect (Art. 44)?
terms: segurança que o titular dele pode esperar

items.text: Are there technical and administrative security measures able to protect against unauthorized access and accidental or unlawful situations, proportionate to the nature of the data (especially sensitive) and the state of the technology?
terms: medidas de segurança, técnicas e administrativas

items.text: Were security and privacy measures applied from the design of the product or service through its execution (privacy by design as a reading of Art. 46 §2)?
terms: desde a fase de concepção do produto ou do serviço

items.text: Does security continue even after the end of processing and extend to anyone who intervenes in any phase?
Are the systems structured to meet security requirements, good practices, governance and the general principles?
terms: estruturados de forma a atender aos requisitos de segurança

items.text: Is there a procedure to assess whether an incident may cause relevant risk or harm and, if so, to notify the ANPD and data subjects?

Does the notification contain the six minimum elements (nature of the data, data subjects, protection measures, risks, reasons for delay, reversal/mitigation measures) and respect the deadline defined by the ANPD ([extrapolation]: check the current regulation)?
terms: descrição da natureza dos dados pessoais afetados

items.text: Is there a record of measures that make the data unintelligible to third parties (relevant to the severity assessment) and a plan for measures ordered by the ANPD (disclosure, mitigation)?
Is there a privacy governance program with management commitment, covering the whole data set and adapted to structure, scale and sensitivity?
Do the policies and safeguards result from a systematic assessment of privacy impacts and risks?
terms: avaliação sistemática de impactos e riscos à privacidade

items.text: Are there transparency and data subject participation mechanisms, internal and external oversight, and integration with general governance?
Are there incident response and remediation plans, and is the program updated through continuous monitoring and periodic assessments?
terms: planos de resposta a incidentes e remediação

items.text: Can the program's effectiveness be demonstrated at the ANPD's request? Are the good-practice rules published and updated?
Do the good-practice rules consider the nature, scope, purpose and the probability and severity of the risks and benefits of the processing?
terms: probabilidade e a gravidade dos riscos e dos benefícios

items.text: Is there evidence for the grading criteria in Art. 52 §1 (good faith, cooperation, internal mechanisms, governance policy, prompt adoption of corrective measures, recidivism)?

Does the organization know the range of sanctions (warning, simple fine of up to 2% of revenue limited to R$ 50 million per infraction, daily fine, publicization, blocking, deletion, suspensions, prohibition)?

Does the system have an inventory of data actions (collection, retention, logging, analysis, generation, merging, disclosure, transfer, disposal) and an indication of which may be problematic for individuals?
Were problematic data actions analyzed (not only unauthorized-access threats), considering the context of use and the perception of typical individuals?
For each risk, were likelihood and impact estimated (with cost proxies when individual impact is hard to assess) and was the residual risk explicitly accepted or treated?
Were potential problems classified (loss of trust, loss of self-determination, discrimination, economic loss) and linked to verifiable system requirements?

Are there capabilities for predictability (no one is surprised; notices tested for comprehension), manageability (granularity to correct, erase, selectively disclose) and disassociability (do not associate beyond what is necessary)?
Does the system boundary used in the analysis cover the whole PII life cycle (collection to disposal), including steps outside the authorization boundary?
